categories.main_business_segments: Lepu Medical Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the cardiovascular disease field, providing full lifecycle solutions including medical devices, pharmaceuticals, medical services, and health management. The main business segments are medical devices (especially cardiovascular interventional devices), pharmaceuticals, and medical services & health management. The medical device segment includes cardiovascular interventional devices, in vitro diagnostics, and surgical anesthesia products. The pharmaceutical segment focuses on cardiovascular disease management drugs, including raw materials and formulations. The company also develops consumer medical products in ophthalmology, dentistry, and dermatology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes innovation in cardiovascular interventional medical devices, utilizing technologies such as drug-eluting stents, bioresorbable scaffolds, cutting balloons, and AI-based ECG analysis. It integrates medical engineering platforms including active device platforms, passive consumables, bioengineering, biodegradable materials, and artificial intelligence. Production follows lean manufacturing principles with dynamic sales-driven production, process optimization, and coordinated office management. R&D is conducted via a two-tier system focusing on foundational research and clinical trial management, with a strong emphasis on clinical needs and product commercialization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lepu serves hospitals and healthcare institutions, especially cardiovascular intervention centers, retail pharmacies (OTC market), and individual consumers for health management products. Its products are used in clinical settings for cardiovascular disease treatment, diagnostics, and surgical procedures. The company also targets county-level markets for pharmaceuticals and consumer medical products. Internationally, it serves healthcare providers and distributors across Asia, Europe, North America, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with production bases in Beijing, Shenzhen, Henan, and Zhejiang. It has established a broad international sales network covering over 160 countries and regions across Asia, Europe, North America, and the Middle East. It is expanding manufacturing capacity in Malaysia to serve Southeast Asian markets. The company holds multiple regulatory certifications including China’s NMPA, US FDA, and EU CE.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lepu operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device and pharmaceutical supply chains. It engages in R&D, manufacturing, and direct sales of medical devices and drugs, as well as providing medical services. The company manages procurement of raw materials and components from a broad supplier base and controls production and distribution channels, including direct sales and agency models.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation, consumer market expansion, and internationalization. R&D priorities include cardiovascular interventional devices (coronary, peripheral, structural heart disease), electrophysiology, heart failure, and neuroregulation. It invests in bioresorbable materials, AI-enabled diagnostics, and minimally invasive surgical tools. The company also pursues platform-based R&D integrating medical engineering and AI technologies. It aims to commercialize innovative products rapidly and expand consumer medical product lines in ophthalmology, dentistry, and dermatology.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of medical devices and pharmaceuticals, including direct sales and distributor/agent channels. The company also earns income from medical services provided via its cardiovascular specialty hospitals and health management platforms. It leverages both hospital-based and retail pharmacy channels domestically, and diversified sales channels internationally. Revenue includes sales of consumables, equipment, drugs, and health monitoring services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lepu is a leading domestic player in the cardiovascular interventional device market in China, recognized as a pioneer with multiple 'first domestic' products. It holds a strong market position in coronary intervention and structural heart disease devices, with a broad product portfolio and extensive clinical adoption. The company competes with multinational and domestic medical device manufacturers, leveraging innovation, clinical validation, and AI integration to maintain competitive advantages. Its diversified business model and international expansion further strengthen its industry standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Lepu reported total revenue of approximately RMB 7.98 billion, a 24.78% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to reduced sales of emergency diagnostic products. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.26 billion, down 42.91%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 25.02 billion, with net assets of RMB 15.98 billion, showing moderate growth. R&D investment remained robust at over RMB 1.24 billion, accounting for 15.56% of revenue. The company maintains a stable financial position with a net asset return of 8.23%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lepu emphasizes comprehensive cardiovascular disease solutions covering the full patient lifecycle, integrating medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and services. It differentiates through pioneering innovation, including bioresorbable cardiovascular implants and AI-powered diagnostics. The company’s platform-based R&D and clinical integration enable rapid product development and commercialization. Its broad product portfolio, strong clinical validation, and extensive sales network provide high-quality, effective, and safe treatment options. The focus on consumer medical products and international expansion further diversifies its value proposition.
